title: 两角色动作时序0912
sourcePolicy: Read-only snapshot of the current working tree, with source SHA256. Does not claim runtime/art acceptance.

conventions.box: [x,y,w,h] in pixels; origin at fighter feet, facing right, negative y is up; projectile box origin at projectile position.
conventions.timing: Base logical timings exclude hitstop, interruptions, cancels and connected command-throw extensions. Startups are durations; first active display frame is startupFrames + 1.
conventions.hurtboxes: Segment defaults use the move input stance; actual airborne/posture changes remain governed by FightSim.
conventions.drawingCount: Logical sprite indices and state mappings are not original drawing counts; all newly planned art remains unfinished.
conventions.utilityRecovery: Utility builder final segment is declared recovery. Meteor spawns may continue during it; do not stop projectile presentation at recoveryStartFrame0.

reachableReactionNotes: A launching hit enters hit_air even if jump inputs are disabled.
If alive on landing: soft knockdown with an attack held may enter getup directly; otherwise knockdown then getup. Hard knockdown cannot skip knockdown. Zero HP may enter ko.
